scripts.build: npm run build -w @app/shared && npm run build -w @app/web && npm run build -w @app/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @app/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build -w @app/shared && npm run test -w @app/server
scripts.db:migrate:pg: node scripts/prisma-postgres.mjs && prisma migrate dev --schema prisma/postgres/schema.prisma
scripts.db:deploy:pg: node scripts/prisma-postgres.mjs && prisma migrate deploy --schema prisma/postgres/schema.prisma
scripts.dev:watch: npm run build -w @app/shared && tsx watch --clear-screen=false --env-file=.env apps/server/src/index.ts
